picks.editorial_note: An international team led by RWTH Aachen published in Nature a reinforcement-learning platform ('HydroGym') that trains AI agents to actively control fluid dynamics, with direct applications spanning energy, transportation, and defense engineering.
picks.title: Training AI Agents that Can Actively Control Fluid Dynamics in Energy, Transportation, and Defense | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: TU Wien-led research published in Nature demonstrates AI systems that can propose novel physics experiments outperforming human-designed setups, a significant step toward AI-driven scientific discovery.
picks.title: Artificial Intelligence Suggests New Physics Experiments

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Generalist-Specialist Collaboration framework pairs a broad medical AI model with lightweight specialist models, a notable architectural advance for precision healthcare AI with strong partnership potential.
picks.title: Novel AI Framework Unites Generalist and Specialist Models for Precision Healthcare
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: EPFL researchers trained large language models to express calibrated uncertainty when proposing experiments, a meaningful methodological advance for AI-accelerated scientific discovery.
picks.title: An AI capable of doubt can optimize scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: NSF is funding a new $30 million Science and Technology Center, led by Michigan State with Georgia Tech among eight partner institutions, to advance predictive modeling of turbulence — a major multi-institution investment in foundational science.
picks.title: New Center Seeks to Unlock the Science of Turbulence for Energy, Flight, and Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $2.88 million DOE award to a University of Houston-led coalition applies AI to strengthen the domestic critical minerals supply chain, tying university research directly to national economic security policy.
picks.title: Department of Energy Awards UH-led Team $2.88M to Use AI to Strengthen America’s Critical Mineral Supply Chain | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen's autonomous research vehicle 'karl.' received a nationwide German testing permit, a regulatory milestone that signals growing government acceptance of AI-driven autonomous vehicle research on public roads.
picks.title: RWTH Receives Nationwide Testing Permit for Autonomous Research Vehicle “karl.” | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: A $1.2 million NSF grant to USF, Purdue, and UT Dallas will develop quantum-resistant, AI-enabled security for next-generation wireless networks, addressing an emerging national infrastructure vulnerability.
picks.title: USF faculty secure $1.2M NSF grant to advance quantum-secure, AI-enabled wireless networks

picks.editorial_note: UNSW Canberra City's launch of major new robotics and drone testing facilities strengthens ties between academia, industry, and government in autonomous systems research.
picks.title: New facilities expand innovation ecosystem at UNSW Canberra City

picks.editorial_note: A viewpoint from Helmholtz researchers arguing Germany and Europe must build independent open frontier AI models reflects a live policy debate over AI sovereignty with implications for research funding priorities.
picks.title: Why we in Germany and Europe need to build our own open frontier models
